emergency.careLine: If you or someone with you has trouble breathing, chest pain, fainting or severe symptoms, seek urgent medical care now. Call your local emergency number.

riskTiers.0: Air quality is good. Normal outdoor activities pose no health risk.
riskTiers.1: Air quality is satisfactory. Sensitive individuals should observe minor symptoms.
riskTiers.2: Air quality is moderate. Sensitive members should avoid prolonged outdoor exertion.
riskTiers.3: Air quality is poor. Limit prolonged outdoor exertion; keep windows closed during smog peaks.
riskTiers.4: Air quality is very poor. Avoid outdoor exertion; run indoor filtration and wear a fitted N95 respirator.
riskTiers.5: Air quality is severe emergency smog. Remain indoors with air filtration running; avoid outdoor activity.
